title: Autoscale a canary · keep the 25% split
provenance: Illustrative group changes, not a recorded Kubernetes run.
maxSurge 1 and maxUnavailable 0 per logical role. Starting groups do not provide Ready capacity.
The controller may combine changes or use a different safe deletion order.

primitives.text: Autoscale a canary · keep the 25% split
maxSurge = 1 · maxUnavailable = 0 per role · Each square is one group
Marker = requested hold · Bars show Ready groups, not traffic weight
An active canary resizes both revisions, including with Deferred.
More demand raises the floor; keep existing groups while new capacity starts.
Grow A to its new 75% share.
Both shares grow. Starting groups do not yet supply Ready capacity.
The restored A groups become Ready.
Grow B to its new 25% share.
Existing excess drains safely; the new ceiling is not an instant deletion order.
Reduce B to the smaller canary share.
Reduce A to the smaller baseline share.
Back to 3 + 1 Prefill and 6 + 2 Decode: still a 25% canary.

An active canary resizes both revisions, including with Deferred. Hold: 6 + 2 Prefill, 12 + 4 Decode. canaryPercent 25; desired 8/16 Prefill/Decode. A: 6/12 groups, 6/12 Ready. B: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. Serving Ready 8/16; floors 8/16; requested 8/16; ceilings 9/17. Illustrative timing.

Existing excess drains safely; the new ceiling is not an instant deletion order. Autoscaler halves desired: 8/16 → 4/8. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 6/12 groups, 6/12 Ready. B: 2/4 groups, 2/4 Ready. Serving Ready 8/16; floors 4/8; requested 8/16; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.

An active canary resizes both revisions, including with Deferred. Reduce B to the smaller canary share. canaryPercent 25; desired 4/8 Prefill/Decode. A: 6/12 groups, 6/12 Ready. B: 1/2 groups, 1/2 Ready. Serving Ready 7/14; floors 4/8; requested 7/14; ceilings 5/9. Illustrative timing.
